ticket.subject: Mobile app crash
ticket.body_text:
Good morning,

On my iPhone, the app closes straight away when I tap Inbox.

Our field technicians only use the iOS app, so they cannot see their new jobs. We reinstalled the app and restarted the phones.

We would like this sorted before the end of the week. Let me know if you need logs.

Kind regards,
Chloe Ferreira

label_notes: clean bug (bug-ios-crash): a core workflow is broken for one customer with no workaround (field staff use only the iOS app), so P2; urgency medium: action needed this week.
